Person and system colors are shown in the key. Data, object, and file
stores use the C4 data cylinder; the horizontal cylinder is a message
bus. Gray dashed rounded frames delimit logical scopes, with the
scope label at the bottom. Solid thin arrows indicate the named
directed interaction. Text colors are adapted for contrast; sizes
fit text.
